parameters.query:
UPDATE leads 
SET 
  score = {{ $json.final_score }},
  metadata = COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
    'tier', '{{ $json.tier }}',
    'tags', '{{ JSON.stringify($json.tags) }}'::jsonb,
    'recommended_action', '{{ $json.recommended_action }}',
    'ai_reasoning', '{{ $json.reasoning }}',
    'last_scored_at', NOW()
  ),
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $json.lead_id }}'::uuid
RETURNING id, score, metadata, updated_at;
